transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Wednesday, September 2. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Pak takes SCO chair, PM Modi slams use of terror as strategic asset. Connectivity Must Respect Territorial Integrity, Says PM Pakistan chaos: PCB seeks answers over Rizwan, Imam picks as Misbah quits committee. Pakistan Cricket Board seeks explanation from its selection committee. The board questioned the rationale behind including Mohammad Rizwan and Imam-ul-Haq. This action follows the team's poor performance in the ongoing England Test series. Several players and coaching staff have been released and replaced amid this overhaul. Oracle layoffs: The 6 am email didn't come, so employees are counting Slack members. Oracle layoffs 2026: The dreaded 6 am layoff email did not arrive on September 1, leaving employees across the US and India tracking Slack member counts and trading rumours of a September 15 date. Managers were asked to list affected staff before Oracle's second fiscal quarter began. After 21,000 job cuts, $55.7 billion in AI data centre spending and $1.8 billion in restructuring charges, Oracle staff are still waiting. 'Every rescue now a miracle': 4,462 still missing in Nepal, hopes dim. TRISHULI BAZAAR (NUWANKOT, NEPAL): Death toll from the Aug 26 Himalayan flood rose to 1,066 across Nepal and Tibet on Tuesday, while 4,462 people remained missing as rescue operations entered a critical phase. UK man finds 600-yr-old Ming jade dog worth £10k in £1 car boot sale box. A man, who bought a Chinese jade dog for just £1 at a UK car boot sale, has discovered an extraordinary treasure. Found in a box, the 600-year-old Ming dynasty carving is now heading to auction, where the rare black-and-green jade dog, the 8.5cm-long carved animal, is expected to fetch up to £10,000. Barefoot mom in sari runs 3km to win rupees 5k for kids' education. PUNE: Ramabai Ranvir had no idea what running a race meant. Joel McCrea's 1933 ranch became 74-acre wildlife preserve and 220-acre parkland. The former ranch of Hollywood star Joel McCrea has been transformed into a haven for wildlife conservation. His family generously donated the estate to establish a wildlife sanctuary and parkland. The area is home to unique native flora and stunning rock formations. Additionally, the historic ranch structures were handed over to local park authorities for ongoing preservation, while educational initiatives and restoration projects thrive on this safeguarded land. Mark Zuckerberg buys 440-acre Irish castle estate; spokesperson says family is 'excited'. Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan have acquired the impressive Strancally Castle, a historic estate sprawling over 440 acres in County Waterford, Ireland. They intend to use this majestic castle as a residence during their trips to Ireland, reinforcing Meta's strong ties to the country where its international headquarters are situated. GST inflow rises by double digits 3rd month in a row. NEW DELHI: GST collections grew at double-digit rates for the third straight month on the back of a 29 percent jump in the mop-up from imports in Aug, while revenue from domestic transactions was up 9.3 percent . Tribunal alters gay ex-IAF man 'dismissal' to 'routine discharge'. NEW DELHI: The principal bench of Armed Forces Tribunal (AFT) has converted the order of dismissal of a non-commissioned IAF officer, who confessed to being gay, into a routine discharge. 'Toxic' day 7: Yash film up 7.2 percent , crosses rupees 313cr worldwide. Yash's film 'Toxic' saw collections rise on its first Tuesday. The movie earned over eight crore rupees net on its seventh day. Its India net collection has now reached two hundred twenty-nine crore rupees. Overseas earnings pushed the worldwide gross collection to three hundred thirteen crore rupees. PM Modi repeats call to 'shun unnecessary gold buys, foreign weddings and holidays'. NEW DELHI: Buoyed by the better-than-expected GDP growth, PM Modi on Tuesday lauded Indian economy's resilience during a period of global crises.

transcript.title: Bhopal and Madhya Pradesh
transcript.text: Now, news closer to home in Bhopal and across Madhya Pradesh. RGPV To Be Replaced By 3 Universities In MP; 'Rajiv Gandhi' Name Dropped. The Madhya Pradesh Cabinet has approved establishing three technical and skill development universities in place of RGPV, with the 'Rajiv Gandhi' name dropped. NGT Orders Mapping Of Sewage Outfalls Into Bhopal Lakes, Seeks Zero Untreated Discharge Plan. The NGT has ordered authorities to identify all sewage outfalls into Bhopal's Upper and Lower lakes and prepare a time-bound plan for zero untreated discharge. 72,950 Teacher Posts Vacant On Paper, But MP To Recruit Only 18,000 In Two Years. Madhya Pradesh will recruit teachers against only 18,000 posts over the next two years despite 72,950 vacancies shown in government records, School Education Minister Uday Pratap Singh said. MP High Court Warns Rajasthan Cop Of rupees 25,000 Warrant Over 'Missing' Newlyweds. The Madhya Pradesh High Court's Indore bench has directed Rajasthan Police to produce newlyweds Krishanpal Singh and Sunita Kumari by September 15. Shutdown drive in Bhopal: Shuttered markets, tense confrontations. rupees 2,600-Crore Ujjain–Garoth Highway Sinks For Second Time In 7 Months; 500-Metre Stretch To Be Rebuilt. The rupees 2,600-crore Ujjain–Garoth National Highway has suffered subsidence for the second time in seven months, with around 500 metres near the railway bridge on Dewas Road now being reconstructed. Madhya Pradesh Cabinet Approves Renaming Of Rajiv Gandhi Technology University. MP Cabinet clears rupees 41,000 crore development push, ratifies rupees 26,619 crore for VB-G RAM G Scheme. Ujjain KD Gate Road Widening: Mosque Portions Removed Amid Protest, Further Action Put On Hold. Ujjain Municipal Corporation began removing portions of Madina Masjid and Jamiatul Quraish Qassaban Masjid near KD Gate for the Nikas Chauraha-Bada Pull road-widening project. Bhopal traders threaten indefinite strike, city bandh over BMC 'shutdown' drive. Overflowing Sewage At Ujjain's Charak Hospital Raises Infection Risk, Mosquito Breeding Concerns. Overflowing sewage and stagnant water at Government Charak Bhavan Hospital in Ujjain have raised hygiene and infection concerns. Madhya Pradesh to provide 25 thousand rupees for laptops to meritorious Class 12 students. Protesters clash with cops, break barricades; traffic hit. Protests, clash on Day 2 of BMC drive; traders threaten Bhopal bandh. As Upper Lake nears full level, NGT orders fresh demarcation. Court sentences man to 3 yrs for molesting minor. Cabinet clears three tech universities, projects worth rupees 41,000cr. Elderly landlord held for raping 6-year-old girl. Rainy Start For September: Heavy Rainfall In Uttarakhand, Madhya Pradesh. MPHC bars post-retirement recovery of excess salary payments from Class III, IV employees.

transcript.text: Moving to business, the economy and the markets. Nifty near make-or-break level; 23,950 holds the key. Coal India (CIL) increased its total coal supplies to 60.60 million tonnes (MT) in August FY 2026-27, registering a 5.50 percent growth over the 57.40 MT supplied during the corresponding month last year. US Oil Tops $90 for First Time Since July Amid Fresh Strikes. US oil prices topped $90 a barrel for the first time since late July as fresh American strikes on Iran raised concerns about prolonged disruptions to energy flows through the Strait of Hormuz. Adani Energy Solutions achieves highest ESG-score in utility sector globally. Adani Energy Solutions (AESL) today said that it has achieved the distinction of being the highest ESG-scored company globally in the Utilities sector as assessed by S and P Global, following the completion of S and P Global's latest Media and Stakeholder Analysis (MSA) review. Cattle futures lower as screwworm restrictions lift. USA-LIVESTOCK/:LIVESTOCK Telge Projects acquires Wheaton Detailing Services Inc. To strengthen its service capabilities in the U.S. structural engineering market Gold falls to two-week low as rising Treasury yields, dollar weigh. GLOBAL-PRECIOUS:Gold falls to two-week low as rising Treasury yields, dollar weigh Mahindra and Mahindra Aug auto sales jump 42 percent to 1.07 lakh units. Total sales include domestic sales of 1,01,594 units (up 40 percent YoY) and exports of 6,054 units (up 71 percent YoY). Wall Street dips as higher yields, rising oil prices mark shaky start to September. USA-STOCKS/ (UPDATE 5, GRAPHIC):US STOCKS-Wall Street dips as higher yields, rising oil prices mark shaky start to September Mahindra and Mahindra tractors sales grow 5 percent to 29,507 units in August. Domestic tractor sales rose 5 percent to 27,595 units while exports remained flat at 1912 units. The can is the new cup for America's caffeine fix. Energy drinks are increasingly replacing coffee for American consumers seeking more energy. SB Energy heads for IPO after Nvidia backs $105 billion OpenAI data-centre project. SB Energy files for an IPO as Nvidia backs its $105 billion OpenAI data-centre project, despite $3.2 billion losses. Sudarshan Chemical divests its stake in VP4 Frankfurt to Celanese Corporation, USA. Sudarshan Chemical Industries announced the sale of its step-down subsidiary VP4 Frankfurt GmbH (VP4 Frankfurt) to Celanese Corporation, USA, further sharpening the company's focus on its core pigments business. Coal India bets rupees 50,000 crore on life beyond coal. Coal India is investing nearly fifty thousand crore rupees in coal gasification projects. Goldman Sachs, BofA and others plan to issue dollar stablecoin together in 2027. A consortium of 21 financial institutions, including Goldman Sachs and Deutsche Bank, plans to launch a dollar-pegged cryptocurrency in early 2027, aiming to expand into stablecoins linked to other G7 currencies due to renewed interest in blockchain amidst rising crypto prices. Iran warns US strikes could tighten Hormuz lock. The Revolutionary Guard Corps of Iran issued a statement claiming that US military strikes would exacerbate conditions in the Strait of Hormuz. Sugar stocks crash: Why share prices fell sharply today , Dealer stock limit news impact decoded. News of the government halving holding limit for sugar dealers from 4,000 quintals to 2,000 quintals negatively impacted price of sugar stocks and sent the sector crashing into the red today. Here's a look: IZMO arm develops innovative 40 GHz RF package for semiconductor devices. IZMO announced that its semiconductor subsidiary, izmo Microsystems, has developed an innovative high frequency RF Quad Flat No-Lead (QFN) package for semiconductor devices operating at frequencies of up to 40 GHz. India invites bids for remaining raw sugar quota. India has opened up applications for its remaining raw sugar import quota, allowing eligible millers and refiners to apply for this lucrative duty-free allocation. The S and P 500 fell 0.7 percent Tuesday. ESDS Software Solution IPO subscribed 135.88 times. The offer received bids for 167.85 crore shares as against 1.23 crore shares on offer. Banks cut FCNR deposit rates by up to 310 basis pts. Indian banks have lowered interest rates on foreign-currency deposits significantly. Big Question: How new Apple CEO John Ternus will move the stock as Tim Cook leaves huge shoes to fill. transcript.title: Money, tax and personal finance
transcript.text: Now to your money — taxes, savings and personal finance. LIC launches two new plans: LIC's Bima Platinum and LIC's Jeevan Raksha; Check details. New LIC plans: Today, Life Insurance Corporation of India has unveiled two innovative insurance plans designed to meet diverse needs. LIC's Bima Platinum focuses on providing savings alongside financial protection, featuring guaranteed additions. On the other hand, Jeevan Raksha offers essential risk coverage for families facing unexpected death. India's first tokenised corporate bond is coming: Expert explains what it means for retail investors and how it works. India is set to test tokenised corporate bonds with REC in September, using blockchain and wholesale CBDC for faster settlement. The pilot will initially be limited to select investors. The move could eventually improve transparency, access and liquidity. Revised NPS rules for subscribers: PFRDA classifies NPS schemes into five categories; how it will make scheme selection easier for you. NPS subscribers will experience significant changes in pension fund categorization and presentation. A new framework standardizes scheme selection, offering five broad categories for subscribers. Lifecycle schemes will be sub-categorized, while MSF schemes will have five distinct equity exposure levels. The pension body also mandates a new procedure for comparing charges, returns, and risk. Will Gen Z be largest, wealthiest generation in history? Report finds youth poised to overtake Boomers by 2029. Will Gen Z become the largest and wealthiest generation in history? A report by Nielsen (NIQ) and World Data Lab found the youth are poised to overtake Boomers' consumer spending by as early as 2029. Wife living in London gives POA to family friend to manage his Vadodara property, friend gifts it to son and daughter-in-law; husband files case and wins in Gujarat HC. Mr Purshotam Ranchhodbhai Pankhania and his late wife living in London trusted their friend and gave him the POA to manage their India property; friend broke trust, grabs it and gifts the property to his son and daughter-in-law; Gujarat HC declares the gift deed void and gives owner relief. Know how Mr Purshotam Ranchhodbhai Pankhania won the case. LIC introduces new Bima Platinum and Jeevan Raksha policies on 70th anniversary: Benefits, returns, tenure and more. Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) CEO and MD R Doraiswamy announced two new policies-- Bima Platinum and Jeevan Raksha policies. While both are described as non-participating and non-linked plans, their structure and benefits are not the same. Check it out. EPF scheme launches EEC 2026: If you missed EPF enrolment, find out whether you can enrol before the October 31 deadline. Salaried employees who want to opt for EPF scheme but could not due to issue with employer can now do so by October 31, 2026 if these conditions are satisfied. Read the article to know more. Credit card transactions rise 24 percent in July, while average spend drops 13.5 percent to rupees 3,460: What's driving the trend?. Credit card transactions increased 24.1 percent year-on-year to 601 million in July, but overall spending only rose 7.4 percent . The average transaction value fell 13.5 percent to rupees 3,460, with consumers favouring smaller purchases through RuPay cards linked to UPI. EPF calculator: How many years to build rupees 2.23 crore from a rupees 50,000 basic salary?. An employee earning rupees 50,000 as monthly basic salary can build a substantial retirement corpus through regular EPF contributions and compound interest. Gold and silver ETFs: Which funds topped the charts in August 2026, how they differ from 1-year return winners. Gold and silver ETFs posted strong gains in August 2026, but their performance over the past year tells a different story. While some funds led the monthly charts, the longer-term leaderboard reveals a notable shift between the two precious metals. Missed August 31 ITR deadline? Know what ITR 3 and ITR 4 filers can do now. ITR deadline: By the end of August 31, 2026, over 7.8 crore individuals completed their income tax return submissions. Those who did not file on time have until December 31, 2026, to submit a belated ITR, incurring possible late fees. Notably, failing to meet this deadline also prevents taxpayers from opting out of the new tax regime, with business income earners unable to revert to the old regime post-deadline. Does your foreign passport take away inherited agricultural land in India? Here's what NRIs need to know. Does foreign citizenship affect inheritance rights in India? Are NRIs allowed to inherit agricultural land legally? Check out. 8th Pay Commission for pensioners: DoPT backs pension revision for past pensioners; has this happened before?. 8th Pay Commission news: The Department of Personnel and Training is advocating for revisions to the Terms of Reference for the 8th Pay Commission. Employee associations are urging the inclusion of pension revisions for those who retired before January 1, 2026. Historically, previous pay commissions, namely the 7th, 6th, 5th, and 4th, have had their Terms of Reference modified by the government to address various concerns, including extended coverage and scope. EPFO releases monthly pension in Kerala: Did you receive it? How to check your credit amount via Umang app, SMS?. EPFO has released monthly pension in Kerala amid Onam celebrations. Here's how subscribers can check their deposit and EPF passbook using the Umang app, official portal, SMS, WhatsApp or missed call. Who is a non-audit taxpayer and who isn't? Why they have different ITR deadlines for AY 2026-27. With the 31 August ITR filing deadline for non-audit taxpayers over, the focus now shifts to taxpayers subject to tax audit. The rules differ based on the nature of income and activity, with separate compliance requirements and a later filing deadline for audit cases. Can NRIs gift money to an HUF and save tax? Check these income clubbing and tax rules before transferring funds. NRIs have the opportunity to gift money to their Hindu Undivided Family (HUF) without incurring immediate tax obligations. However, it's important to note that any income generated from these gifted amounts will be taxable for the NRI donor. The HUF must diligently keep records of all transactions as this documentation is essential in proving the legitimacy and source of the gift, ensuring NRIs avoid potential tax disputes in the future. ITR deadline: Who must file returns by 31 October, what is the penalty for missed deadline? Key points to know. ITR deadline: Companies and taxpayers whose accounts are required to be audited, the due date for FY26 / AY27 is 31 October. Here's a look at the penalty for missed deadline and date for belated returns. Will I inherit my family's land in India if I become an NRI?. ET Wealth Reader's Query: I would like to understand what happens to my rights over inherited agricultural land in India if I acquire foreign citizenship. Will I still be able to inherit my family's agricultural land, and are there any restrictions on holding, transferring, or disposing of such property after becoming a foreign citizen? Defaulting on a bank loan: Can an individual borrower be jailed? Know the legal and financial risks. A missed EMI can have consequences beyond penalties and a lower credit score.
